top_band: none — in column x=8 each block has only a 1-2 row light cap (rows 2-3, L=131-173) directly under the outline, then the mid-brown face; no distinct top surface
evidence: The left column (x=3) is one uniform wood run of 48 rows with no top surface. The right blocks are repeated front-face planks with only a 1-2px light edge at the top, which is a rim only. No horizontal beam or base shows a top face, so this is not a frame with visible top faces. It reads as a flat front-elevation strip, not an open frame, so kind does not match.

Flat-fill coverage is 0%, but the piece is a repetitive, simple strip with little grain compared with the detailed references, so it looks thinner and flatter next to them.
